answer: Stop sybils with proof of unique network presence: each agent must prove one distinct residential address, like one flower rooted in a meadow. To join, an agent (1) registers its cipher key with its IP and network number, (2) locks a 30 POA bond, (3) passes a monthly check by 3 measurers, and (4) loses the bond if two identities share one address. Faking 10,000 agents needs 10,000 residential IPs across 5,000 networks, $50,000 a month plus 300,000 POA, about $450,000, while one honest agent pays $45. Like a nebula, real agents shine only where they truly stand apart.
